W6 after E055. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost is pixel-proportional compute plus a bandwidth-bound part (BN/GELU/pointwise, ~27% of a 32 px step). Tip E049 reads 5.198 s and 0.7535 on seeds 0–2. Same-commit rebuilds read about ±0.04 s in time and about ±0.3 pp in the 3-seed accuracy mean.

Mechanisms and support:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 1.5–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near the dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048).
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share, because frozen blocks also skip BN/GELU backward, the optimizer update and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049, E053). Group 2 shows no cliff by 85% (E053).
4. Group 1 needs steady training and 32 px exposure. E037 (freeze at 60%) lost 0.45 pp, E054 lost 0.35 pp, and E055 (freeze at 71%) read 0.7519, about −0.15 pp. So the stem loss is roughly a graded dose and not a sharp cliff.
5. Averaging, LS, warm-up, Lookahead-interval, BN-recalibration and batch-split tweaks are null or negative. The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. wd ×0.5 helped about 0.2 pp (E016).
7. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses accuracy faster than it saves time.
8. Build noise is the main obstacle. The 3-seed mean moves by ±0.3 pp across rebuilds (E050 read 0.7552 for the same commit as E036's 0.7532 and 0.7497). Seed-set selection adds winner's curse of about 0.1–0.2 pp.
9. The population mean of the tip is about 0.752–0.754, so the 0.753 bar is barely cleared. Time cuts bought with accuracy mostly fail the bar and are discarded.

Misses: the group-2 freezes and trims saved more time than I forecast (E046, E048, E052). Accuracy ranges need to stay about ±0.35 pp wide.

Unsure: the true tip mean, the rebuild SD, PCIe transfer, and whether the coarse-label data are available under the rules.

forecasts.reason: Diagnostic. Rebuild SD of a 20-seed mean is probably about 0.08–0.12 pp, and the fresh-seed mean reads a little below 0.7539.
E052 and E053 sit near 0.7515 population, so a strict 1.64σ gate probably fails them, and the gate result is marginal.
E046 is 0.25 epoch fewer than E049, so I expect about −0.1 pp for −0.1 s. That is within rebuild noise.
The coarse labels are likely in the train pickle, but whether the rules allow them is unclear. The gain is small if it runs.
The code already freezes the BN weight (requires_grad=False), so the idea closes by reading the code.
The effect is tiny, within noise, and accuracy is probably flat.
Diagnostic. The curves probably separate whitening from group 1 but only loosely order group 1 against group 2.

cruxes: What is the rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean (H4.5.1)? It decides whether any sub-0.15 pp keep decision is real.
Is the fresh-seed population mean of E049, E052 and E053 at or above 0.751? That sets how much time can still be bought with accuracy margin.
Do the coarse labels exist in the shipped training data and do the rules allow them? If so, they are a time-free accuracy lever.
